description: Every SSA-specific guest address the port depends on: name, role, scope and, per entry, the shape of its byte signature (length in words, candidates, occurrence, data reference). NO game bytes are committed. The signatures themselves (SSA's code with relocations and operands masked) are generated from the user's own disc into private/giants/ssa_sigs.json (untracked) by `python3 -I tools/sigmatch/sigmatch.py make docs/giants/ssa_hooks.json`, and read by `... match`. scope: lux = Lux engine code (expected in Giants), xbox = XDK/CRT code (expected in Giants, maybe a newer XDK), ssa = this build's layout only.

not_signed.switch_tables: config/SSA_switch_tables.toml (~1000 tables): regenerate with tools/find_switch_tables.py on the new image; never port by hand
not_signed.setjmp: setjmp_address/longjmp_address are config entries below; XenonRecomp's setjmp handling needs only those two
not_signed.midasm_hooks: none: SSA.toml has no midasm_hook entries; all runtime hooks are whole-function overrides (PPC_FUNC)
not_signed.struct_offsets: d3d/*.cpp and d3d/ring.h rely on D3D device offsets (device+0x328C pixel shader, +0x3290 vertex shader, +0x2B1C fence, +0x35E8 command buffer...) of the XDK D3D9 build SSA links; check each against the Giants functions sigmatch finds (same XDK = same offsets)
not_signed.loose_matches: tools/sigmatch masks immediates in loose mode, so a hook found loose may have a changed struct offset: read its asm before trusting the hook's offsets
not_signed.test_aids: SKY_SKIP_MOVIES (Movie_Update), SKY_LEVEL (paths in kernel/files.cpp, not addresses), SKY_PORTAL_LOG (Portal_Log)

entries.name: inflateInit2_
entries.why: host zlib is much faster than the recompiled one (file/STR decompression)

entries.name: inflate
entries.why: host zlib, same reason

entries.name: inflateEnd
entries.why: host zlib, same reason

entries.name: Audio_SetLanguage
entries.what: audio start-up language (r3 = language code): sets Wwise's language folder and every file package's language
entries.why: voices in another language than the text (settings voice_language)

entries.name: Movie_VoiceTrack
entries.what: picks a cutscene's Bink voice track (r3 out, r4 = has localized voices)
entries.why: cutscene voices follow the voice language

entries.name: Ngl_SceneTraversal
entries.what: NGL scene traversal from ListSendModule; skipped when the current scene (NglCurrentScene) is null
entries.why: a frame submitted with no scene (first movie) dereferenced null

entries.name: Ngl_ListSubmit
entries.what: NGL render list submission (scene+0x348); skipped when r3 is null
entries.why: frames drawn while a movie has no picture: empty list crashed

entries.name: Heap_Free
entries.what: main heap free (r3 heap, r4 payload); a double free or a free next to a corrupt block is logged and leaked
entries.why: users crashed in coalescing while the frontend loads (docs/handoff_sigbus.md); cause not found

entries.name: Xma1_Init
entries.what: XMA engine 1 (XAudio2 copy) init: creates the context array first
entries.why: each engine reads the context array address once at init

entries.name: Xma2_Init
entries.what: XMA engine 2 (Wwise copy) init: creates the context array first
entries.why: same

entries.name: Xma1_VoiceClear
entries.what: engine 1 register writer (voice group create/clear) run under the XMA mutex (CallWriter)
entries.why: the APU context registers are emulated; writes must be observed

entries.name: Xma1_VoiceKick
entries.why: same

entries.name: Xma2_VoiceClear
entries.why: same

entries.name: Xma2_VoiceLock
entries.why: same

entries.name: Xma2_VoiceKick
entries.why: same

entries.name: Xma1_LockAll
entries.what: engine 1 locks all voices; the hook takes Engine1CriticalSection first
entries.why: lock order guest-then-ours avoids a deadlock

entries.name: Portal_Log
entries.what: the title's printf-like portal log, silent in retail; echoed with SKY_PORTAL_LOG
entries.why: portal debugging

entries.name: D3DDevice_BeginCommandBuffer
entries.why: recorded command buffers are replayed by the host (docs/command_buffers.md)

entries.name: D3DDevice_EndCommandBuffer
entries.why: same

entries.name: D3DDevice_RunCommandBuffer
entries.what: D3DDevice_RunCommandBuffer: guest version emits INDIRECT_BUFFER nobody executes; host replays and marks non-persisted groups dirty
entries.why: autosave panel texture etc.

entries.name: D3DDevice_NextRingSegment
entries.what: moves the ring write position to the next segment (from ReserveCommandSpace, KickOff, Swap)
entries.why: the PM4 ring is read by the host at segment boundaries (d3d/ring.h)

entries.name: D3DDevice_CreateVertexShader
entries.why: maps guest shaders to the XenosRecomp cache

entries.name: D3DDevice_CreatePixelShader
entries.why: same

entries.name: D3DDevice_KickOff
entries.why: no real GPU: kick-off executes immediately (null_gpu)

entries.name: D3DDevice_BlockOnFence
entries.what: BlockOnFence: a fence in unsubmitted commands needs a kick-off; nothing else is pending
entries.why: the guest spins on a GPU-written fence otherwise

entries.name: D3DDevice_InsertCallback
entries.what: InsertCallback queues the callback instead of writing CP-interrupt packets
entries.why: no CP interrupts

entries.name: D3DDevice_DrawVertices
entries.what: DrawVertices(device, prim, start, count): drawn once the guest wrote its state into the ring
entries.why: host draws

entries.name: D3DDevice_DrawIndexedVertices
entries.why: host draws

entries.name: D3DDevice_BeginVertices
entries.what: BeginVertices(device, prim, count, stride) -> buffer the game fills
entries.why: host draws (UP draws)

entries.name: D3DDevice_Resolve
entries.what: Resolve(device, flags, rect, dest, point, level, slice, clear...)
entries.why: EDRAM resolves done by the host

entries.name: D3DDevice_ClearF_Worker
entries.what: ClearF/BeginTiling/BeginZPass worker: clears with a rectangle draw
entries.why: host clear

entries.name: D3DDevice_Swap
entries.what: Swap(device, frontBuffer, ...): presents the resolved texture
entries.why: host present

entries.name: LightTile_ClassifyJob
entries.what: light pre-pass tile classification job (worker): r4 first tile of the depth resolve, r8 tiles/row, r10 first row; records the resolve address for WriteBackDepth
entries.why: the job reads tiled EDRAM depth from guest memory: host must write depth back first (shadow tile job)

entries.name: BinkDoFrame
entries.why: Bink frames drawn by the GPU path (d3d/bink_display.cpp)

entries.name: Movie_Update
entries.what: Movie_Update(movie) returns movie+0x80 (playing); SKY_SKIP_MOVIES=1 clears it after one frame
entries.why: test runs skip movies

entries.name: LanguageIndex
entries.what: the title's language index (set by sub_82808190)
entries.why: read or locked by the runtime

entries.name: LanguageCodes
entries.what: table of 15 char* language codes (disc folder names)
entries.why: read or locked by the runtime

entries.name: NglCurrentScene
entries.what: scene list nglListSend hands to ListSendModule
entries.why: read or locked by the runtime

entries.name: Engine1CriticalSection
entries.why: read or locked by the runtime

entries.name: DeviceGlobal
entries.what: NGL global holding the D3D device pointer
entries.why: read or locked by the runtime
